name: Stripe SDK
description: It would be hard to imagine a world where Stripe doesn't exist. Their web API documentation is the gold standard of developer experience. I started using their API in 2018, and I remember being impressed by how much I could do as a one-person show. It's one of the products with the most significant effort/reward ratio... Imagine building a payment portal from scratch, a developer's nightmare. Whenever I come back to Stripe for new clients' projects, they somehow manage to make their service even more enjoyable and intuitive to use. Bravo, Stripe!
